details.jobDescription:
As a Senior Full Stack Developer in our team, you will play a pivotal role in the design, development and maintenance of our insurance applications. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet our clients' needs. We're seeking a passionate developer who can take ownership of projects, able to work autonomously, demonstrate creativity and stay updated with the latest industry trends. For this role good knowledge of C#, .Net as well as React and open API web services are needed.︁︀​︂︀︀​︁︂︉​︇︉

Qualifications:
  • Over 5 years of applicable knowledge, skills and experience with C# and .Net as well as SQL;
  • Experience in the development of web applications with relevant technologies (JavaScript, Typescript, CSS, JSON, Visual Studio, React);
  • Able to work autonomously and write the clear code.
  • Good OOP and SOLID code knowledge;
  • Experience in one or more client libraries / frameworks is considered a plus (Angular, React, Vue);
  • Awareness of Software Development Life Cycle; Awareness of Agile Development software;
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps Server / Microsoft is an advantage;
  • Willingness to learn and understand the world of insurance;
  • Openness to people and ideas, as well as enjoyment of varied tasks;
  • Strong ambition to develop high-quality solutions;
  • Good English skills;

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with our team Business System Analysts, Software Architects and other developers to understand project requirements and objectives;

  • Take over technical analysis for selected requirements;

  • Develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our applications;

  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using modern programming languages and frameworks;

  • Take care of the quality of developed solutions and components via proper testing (developer tests, functional tests);

  • Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring optimal performance and reliability for technical production issues (3rd level support);

  • Continuous research and stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices to enhance development processes.

Our offer

  • For this full-time position, we offer an attractive compensation package that matches your qualifications and experience;

  • An office in the heart of the city: Boulevard Carol I, 31-33;

  • Hybrid work schedule: up to 15 WFH available;

  • A dynamic but friendly, safe and stable environment;

Diversitatea oamenilor noștri joacă un rol major în succesul nostru. Ne-am angajat să promovăm diversitatea în mediul de lucru și ne mândrim că oferim oportunități corecte tuturor. Ne folosim de experiența noastră, știm cum să ne apropiem de clienții noștri. Indiferent de experiența profesională și personală, căutăm candidați care să aibă curajul și devotamentul de a juca un rol în dezvoltarea noastră și de a adăuga plus valoare culturii noastre. Muncim susținut, dar credem în colaborare, creștere și responsabilitate.

O poziție la VIG deschide o serie de perspective excelente de dezvoltare pentru absolvenții de universitate și pentru profesioniștii cu expertiză de specialitate.
